# raspberrypi pico-examples (five programs)

Unmodified copies of five programs from https://github.com/raspberrypi/pico-examples (BSD-3-Clause, `LICENSE`), built for MSPM0 through `portability/pico-on-mspm0/`. Each folder's `SOURCE.md` gives the upstream folder and commit. Results: `ports/pico-sdk/README.md`.
